import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static final long MODFINAL = 1000000007L;
    static long[] pw10 = new long[17];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();

        String nStr = Long.toString(n);
        // Build n_str as reversed? Actually original builds by taking digits and reversing.
        // But we can just use nStr directly since it's the decimal representation.
        // However, original code builds n_str by taking digits from n and then reversing.
        // Let's replicate exactly: n_str is the decimal string of n.
        // The code: for (int64_t t = n; t; t /= 10) n_str += char('0' + t % 10); std::reverse(ALL(n_str));
        // So n_str is the decimal representation of n.
        // We already have nStr as decimal, so we can use it.
        // But careful: the original code builds n_str by reversing, so it's the same as nStr.
        // We'll use nStr.

        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i)
            pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];

        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.ZERO;

        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

            for (int firstdiff = 0; firstdiff < nStr.length() && firstdiff < len; ++firstdiff) {
                if (firstdiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (nStr.charAt(firstdiff - 1) - '0');
                    curst.append(nStr.charAt(firstdiff - 1));
                }

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; ++lastdig) {
                    if (firstdiff == 0 && lastdig == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (lastdig == nStr.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;
                    if (len == nStr.length() && lastdig > nStr.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;

                    long curp = 10 * cur + lastdig;
                    String curstp = curst.toString() + (char)('0' + lastdig);

                    long base = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curstp.length(); ++pos) {
                        char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                        for (char dig = start; dig < curstp.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                            base += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                        tmp.append(curstp.charAt(pos));
                    }
                    base += len - 1;

                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int pos = curstp.length(); pos < len; ++pos) {
                        variables.add((int)(countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + '0', n, nStr) % MOD));
                        tmp.append('0');
                    }

                    base += 1;
                    base -= curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    for (int t = 0; t < variables.size(); ++t)
                        variables.set(variables.size() - 1 - t, (int)((variables.get(variables.size() - 1 - t) - pw10[t] % MOD) % MOD));

                    base %= MOD;
                    if (base < 0)
                        base += MOD;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); ++i) {
                        int val = variables.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (val < 0)
                            val += MOD;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }

                    solve(variables, (int)base, ans);
                }
            }
        }

        long cur = 0;
        StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            curst.append(nStr.charAt(len - 1));
            cur = 10 * cur + (nStr.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1;
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curst.length(); ++pos) {
                char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                for (char dig = start; dig < curst.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                    val += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                tmp.append(curst.charAt(pos));
            }
            val += len - 1;

            val -= cur;
            val %= MOD;
            if (val < 0)
                val += MOD;

            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }

        ans = ans.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(MODFINAL));
        System.out.println(toString(ans));
    }

    static String toString(BigInteger num) {
        return num.toString();
    }

    static long countWithPrefix(String s, long n, String nStr) {
        long ans = 0;
        long sVal = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray())
            sVal = 10 * sVal + (ch - '0');

        for (int len = s.length(); len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            if (len < nStr.length()) {
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            } else {
                // compare first s.length() characters
                String prefix = nStr.substring(0, s.length());
                int cmp = s.compareTo(prefix);
                if (cmp < 0) {
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                } else if (cmp == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - sVal * pw10[nStr.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void solve(List<Integer> variables, int base, BigInteger ans) {
        int[] cur = new int[1];
        int until;
        List<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rem2;

        // first brute
        cur[0] = base;
        until = variables.size() / 2;
        brute(0, until, cur, variables, rem1);
        rem2 = rem1;
        rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        cur[0] = 0;
        until = variables.size();
        brute(variables.size() / 2, until, cur, variables, rem1);

        // sort both lists
        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalrsum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2)
            totalrsum += b;

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && a + rem2.get(j) >= MOD)
                --j;
            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(a).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(rem2.size())));
            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(totalrsum));
            ans = ans.subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(rem2.size() - 1 - j).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(MOD)));
        }
    }

    static void brute(int pos, int until, int[] cur, List<Integer> variables, List<Integer> rem1) {
        if (pos == until) {
            rem1.add(cur[0]);
            return;
        }
        int oldcur = cur[0];
        for (int t = 0; t < 10; ++t) {
            brute(pos + 1, until, cur, variables, rem1);
            cur[0] += variables.get(pos);
            if (cur[0] >= MOD)
                cur[0] -= MOD;
        }
        cur[0] = oldcur;
    }
}
